Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Field.Name: Version

Message.Name: Options Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, PHLX disseminates directory messages for all symbols trading on the PHLX option system.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: PHLX Option ID assigned daily, valid for the trading day

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option symbol (security symbol) post-symbology rollout. Denotes the root portion of the OPRA symbol pre-symbology rollout

Field.Name: Expiration
Field.Description: Denotes the explicit expiration date of the option.

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Denotes the explicit strike price of the option. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Identifies the source of the Option, valid for the trading day

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the unique underlying stock symbol for the option symbol. Normally matches the stock symbol. The exception is for corporate actions assigned by PHLX

Field.Name: Option Closing Type
Field.Description: Denotes the closing of the option.

Field.Name: PHLX Tradable
Field.Description: Denotes whether or not this option is tradable at the PHLX exchange.

Message.Name: Complex Order Strategy Message
Message.Description: Whenever a complex order is added in the system for an underlying, the order is normalized and results in either the creation of a new complex strategy or is added to an existing strategy. A Complex Order Strategy Message containing the strategy definition will be sent.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: PHLX Strategy ID assigned daily, valid while there are any open complex orders for the day

Field.Name: Source
Field.Description: Identifies the source of the Strategy, valid for the trading day

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for the strategy. All legs in this strategy belong to this Underlying

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Defines the state of the strategy

Field.Name: Number of Legs
Field.Description: Number of legs in the strategy

Field.Name: Complex Order Strategy Leg
Field.Description: Leg information

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: When a symbol goes into an auction, an Auction Notification Message is sent. Also if any auction parameters change during the auction, size for example, a new Auction Notification message will be sent for that symbol.

Field.Name: Seconds
Field.Description: Seconds portion of the timestamp

Field.Name: Nanoseconds
Field.Description: Nanoseconds portion of timestamp

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: PHLX Option ID assigned daily, valid for the trading day

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option symbol post-symbology rollout. Denotes the root portion of the OPRA symbol pre-symbology rollout

Field.Name: Expiration
Field.Description: Denotes the explicit expiration date of the option.

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Denotes the explicit strike price of the option. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Option Type:

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Uniquely identifies the Auction for the trading day. Presently the Auction ID will be zero for non-PIXL auctions.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Type of Auction:

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price at which auction is started. For PIXL auctions, price is zero. The price at which an exposed order is available for execution.

Field.Name: Auction Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the auction:

Field.Name: Matched Volume
Field.Description: Volume that can be traded at Price. For Order Exposure, Matched Volume is zero

Field.Name: Imbalance Volume
Field.Description: Total number of contracts better than Price (includes Orders that cannot be filled). The Exposed Order size.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use

Message.Name: Complex Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: When a Complex Order Live Auction (COLA) or PIXL/Solicitation auction starts for a strategy of an underlying, a COLA/PIXL/Solicitation notification message containing the auction information will be sent.
